prediction_unit: trial; all inner/outer scores use one row per participant-condition trial
label_1: sustained TLim knee-extension task carried to task failure
outer_validation: leave one participant out; both paired trial conditions for that subject are held out
inner_tuning: 3-fold GroupKFold on outer-training participants; grouped macro-F1 selection
prediction_threshold: 0.5 for probabilities, zero for signed SVM margins

base_estimator_settings.random_forest: 200 trees, balanced class weights, square-root feature subsampling
base_estimator_settings.hist_gradient_boosting: early stopping disabled; inner participant groups select iterations/leaves/regularization
base_estimator_settings.mlp_compact: StandardScaler + MLPClassifier(solver=lbfgs, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4); compact hidden layers tuned within participant groups
base_estimator_settings.logistic_regression: StandardScaler + balanced LogisticRegression, C selected within participant groups

cnn.architecture: compact temporal depthwise CNN over 65-channel x 0.5-s windows
cnn.trial_pooling: mean window logit; binary cross-entropy computed once per trial bag
cnn.windows_per_trial: 8 evenly spaced from the 32 preprocessed windows
cnn.normalization: median channel RMS fit from training participants only per fold

pretrained_encoder_head.reason: the course SSL encoder was trained on a single-channel signal and unlabeled reconstruction; this external release has a 65-position electrode grid, a different sampling rate/protocol, and participant overlap with the course cohort is unverified. Channel adaptation and unverified identity overlap would invalidate a clean external comparison.

limits: the target distinguishes a reference protocol condition from a trial carried to task failure; it is not an instantaneous fatigue/no-fatigue label
the external source uses isometric 30% peak-torque knee extension, unlike the course dynamic 70% 1RM task
the uncalibrated force trace is used only for segmentation and is excluded from model features and labels
only 14 complete paired participants are available; uncertainty is participant-clustered and expected to be wide
